_readme: Explicit Qikink SKUs. Anything here beats the codes derived in server/skus.js.
`variants` is keyed by '<slug>/<colourway>/<size>' from js/products.js. A
value may be a plain SKU string, or an object:
Set search_from_my_products to 1 for a product saved under Qikink's
'My Products' (dashboard.qikink.com -> Products -> My Products) — their API
then pulls the design/placement itself and no `designs` array is sent.
Leave it 0 (or omit) for a raw blank SKU from 'SKU Descriptions', which
needs print_type_id/placement_sku and a `designs` entry per order.
The 'anime-clear-case' entry below is transcribed from the dashboard's My
Products list (Product ID 64640642, 'Hard Clear Case', iPhone 16 Pro only).
The sku value is what the list view showed next to the product name —
confirm it against the product's own detail/edit page before taking real
orders; the list view may show a truncated or composite string rather than
`caseModels` (style/phone-model -> SKU) is here for when more real Qikink
products get added and a whole model range shares one blank per style.
